text: {"C1":{"score":10,"justification":"The opening includes the company name, the agent's full name, and an offer of service/assistance, delivered in the first line of the call.","evidence":"Gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza, le atiende Paola Enríquez."},"C2":{"score":10,"justification":"Before proposing anything, the agent established the vehicle, its age/value, current premium, the competitor benchmark, the budget pressure, and the must-keep coverage, then explicitly confirmed her understanding.","evidence":"Muy bien, entonces: Jetta 2018, cobertura amplia con cristales, y buscamos bajar de mil quinientos..."},"C3":{"score":10,"justification":"Recording disclosure is given in the opening line, and the pricing discussed is a renewal on an existing policy she has on screen and immediately executes, with no coverage guarantees or legal advice.","evidence":"Le comento que esta llamada puede ser grabada para calidad."},"C4":{"score":10,"justification":"The reason for the call is fully resolved: the renewal is processed with a concrete amount, delivery of the policy today, and a specific billing date.","evidence":"Le va a llegar la póliza renovada hoy mismo a su correo, y el primer cargo con el monto nuevo sale el día quince como siempre."},"C5":{"score":10,"justification":"The agent is courteous throughout, lets the customer finish, acknowledges personal context appropriately, and keeps the call focused on the renewal decision.","evidence":"Claro, felicidades a su hija por cierto. Entonces la meta sería quedar más cerca de lo que paga su amigo, sin perder lo que ya tiene."}}
